title: 2023 HMMT November Team Problem 7
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a convex trapezoid such that \(\angle B A D=\angle A D C=90^{\circ}, A B=20, A D=21\), and \(C D=28\). Point \(P \neq A\) is chosen on segment \(A C\) such that \(\angle B P D=90^{\circ}\). Compute \(A P\).

solutions.text:
Construct the rectangle \(A B X D\). Note that

\[\angle B A D=\angle B P D=\angle B X D=90^{\circ}\]

so \(A B X P D\) is cyclic with diameter \(B D\). By Power of a Point, we have \(C X \cdot C D=C P \cdot C A\). Note that \(C X=C D-X D=C D-A B=8\) and \(C A=\sqrt{A D^{2}+D C^{2}}=35\). Therefore,

\[C P=\frac{C X \cdot C D}{C A}=\frac{8 \cdot 28}{35}=\frac{32}{5}\]

and so

\[A P=A C-C P=35-\frac{32}{5}=\frac{143}{5}\]
